channel.description: Recent content in Code Quality on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: github: Download GitHub Code Quality license usage as a CSV
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality now lets administrators download a CSV report of license usage to reconcile license counts with internal records. The report lists each active committer covered by the license usage data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Audit GitHub Code Quality finding dismissals and reopenings
item.description:
GitHub audit logs now include manual dismissals and reopenings of GitHub Code Quality findings at the organization or enterprise level. This lets admins review actions on findings that appear in a repository’s default-branch backlog or other Code Quality views.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code coverage uploads no longer fail CI for new branches
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality’s upload-code-coverage action no longer causes CI failures when coverage is uploaded from a branch that does not yet have an open pull request. This changes behavior from the previous failure case for new branches.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Remediate Code Quality findings with agentic autofix
item.description:
GitHub added agentic autofix for Code Quality findings, allowing users to select and assign up to 25 standard findings at once for automated remediation. The feature is aimed at reducing backlog items in code quality reports.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Track GitHub Code Quality enablement changes in the audit log
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality now emits audit log events when it is enabled, disabled, or its repository settings are changed. This adds a history trail for Code Quality configuration changes.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Track organization code quality trends
item.description:
GitHub’s organization-level Code Quality dashboard now has a Trends tab. It shows code quality changes across repositories over time instead of only a point-in-time view.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code coverage automatic enablement in Code Quality settings
item.description:
GitHub added a new Code Quality setting that can automatically generate a code coverage workflow with AI. The change is meant to reduce setup time for coverage in repositories.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Code Quality is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality is now generally available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Team. The announcement says it is intended to help with the growing volume of code produced with AI assistance.

  • Source: GitHub
